headline: From more taxes "on the wealthy" to "the friendship union": Pedro Sánchez's promises in his electoral program for 29N
summary: Pedro Sánchez committed to higher taxes on rentiers and to enshrining pension revaluation in the Constitution in his electoral programme for the November 29 vote. He would need a broad congressional majority.
why: Tax and pension policy changes affect Spain's fiscal outlook, government bond supply and household income, which matter to investors in Spanish assets.

original_headline: De más impuestos "a los de arriba" a "la unión de amistad": las promesas de Pedro Sánchez en su programa electoral para el 29N
